descriptions.preferred: A chance dissectum seedling with 'Viridis' as a possible parent, this cultivar is very pretty in the spring as the young leaves appear. Its emerging light green leaves are attractively edged in red, a color combination which lasts through spring and into early summer. In all other redissectum -red

sources.title: 春日喜悦 Acer Palmatum 'Spring Delight'
sources.description: 由美国俄勒冈州巴克霍兹苗圃的苗圃主泰隆·巴克霍兹 培育并推广，翠绿枝垂的种子实生苗选育而来，春天新 叶为黄色并有粉红色的叶尖，黄色持续时间略短，快速 变为绿色，五月新稍为棕黄色或者棕红色，和绿色的老 叶形成鲜明的对比，秋季为橙黄色或者纯黄色，生长强 劲，叶型略大，可全日照，成年株可达 1.8 米。

sources.name: Spring Delight Green/Pink Laceleaf Japanese Maple
sources.description: The Spring Delight is a very nice low growing Canopy shape Japanese maple, with green leaves and pink accent colors. They grow to about 8-10 ft, and are very attactive with the larger leaf shape but still dissected. You will be very happy with the bright spring colors.

rhs.description: A slow-growing, deciduous Japanese maple about 2.5m tall, with a strongly cascading habit forming a dome at maturity. Leaves have 7 to 9-lobes, are finely dissected and very narrow, emerging pale green edged red, in spring, becoming bright green in summer, then turning gold with an occasional splash of crimson in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个偶然获得的 dissectum 实生苗，可能以 'Viridis' 为亲本。春季新叶展开时尤为美丽。初生叶片为浅绿色，叶缘带红，色彩搭配十分悦目，这种效果可持续整个春季并延续至初夏。 在所有红叶重裂类型中，'Stella Rossa' 是意大利米兰附近 Fratelli Gilardelli 苗圃于 20 世纪 60 年代后期选育出的较早品种之一。其幼叶呈极具观赏性的粉红红色，随后转为深紫红色，并能很好地保持整个夏季及初秋，秋季再转为鲜红色。其叶色与 'Dissectum Nigrum' 相似，但深红色保持时间更长。叶片 7 裂，深裂且细裂，长宽均为 9-12 厘米。每个裂片向基部明显变窄，最下部 1-1.5 厘米仅剩中脉。裂片上部约四分之三处分裂为较宽、较平展的小裂片，边缘具精细锯齿。叶柄为红色。 这一大叶型栽培品种是红叶 Matsumurae Group 中的优良品种之一。叶片 7 裂（最大的叶片有时会出现额外 2 个极小裂片），长 7-9 厘米，宽 9-12 厘米，深裂几近叶基。裂片为长卵形，在中部最宽处宽 1-1.5 厘米，在裂片结合处缩窄至 2-5 毫米。裂片外端逐渐收尖成细长锐尖。各裂片分离明显。外侧边缘具重锯齿，齿端尖且略呈钩状；内侧边缘平滑。叶柄红色，长 2.5-4 厘米。春季叶色为鲜紫红色。初夏时叶片加深，近黑红或极深栗紫色。仲夏至秋季，颜色逐渐转为深绿红或褐红色。 绿色重裂型

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 生长缓慢的落叶性日本枫，株高约 2.5 米，枝姿强烈下垂，成熟时形成圆拱形树冠。叶片 7 至 9 裂，深裂且裂片极狭长；春季新叶淡绿，边缘带红；夏季转为鲜绿色；秋季变为金黄色，间或染有深红色。
